title: Continuous Curved 2D Spiral Manifold (Published Prior Cohort)
intuition: Published-prior cohort variant of `vector_spiral` with explicit `learnable=True` MoG prior declaration, testing transfer consistency across minor prior-contract differences. Tests continuous curved probability mass (1.5-turn Archimedes spiral with radial noise sigma=0.08) rather than a finite table of point clusters, checking global sliced W1, mean, and covariance fidelity.
failure_mode: Overly rigid discrete prototype charts quantize the smooth spiral into beads or cut straight chords across inner turns.
protocol_notes: Separate published transfer cohort of `vector_spiral`; historical sensitivity observed across architectures.
